name: TouchEQ 8
author: GreasyCratez
summary: 8-band parametric EQ with a live filled curve and spectrum analyser: pick a band and drag its point with a finger. Each band is one row of four Q-Links (Freq, Gain, Q, Type), and QLink Follow moves the knobs to the band you tap. 48/12 dB cuts, shelves, bells and notch, Adaptive Q, Scale and Mix.
